name: TC_D11_UnauthenticatedRequest
description: Sends a delete request with no session cookies. An unauthenticated delete that succeeds is a critical authorisation bypass — any anonymous caller could empty another user's cart. Must return 401/403/302 or HTTP 200 with error_code != 0.
